name: Status of Tasks Over Time
description: The 5 task-status counts above, summed across connectors, over time.
programText:
data('kafka_connect_connect_worker_metrics_connector_running_task_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum().publish(label='running')
data('kafka_connect_connect_worker_metrics_connector_failed_task_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum().publish(label='failed')
data('kafka_connect_connect_worker_metrics_connector_paused_task_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum().publish(label='paused')
data('kafka_connect_connect_worker_metrics_connector_unassigned_task_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum().publish(label='unassigned')
data('kafka_connect_connect_worker_metrics_connector_destroyed_task_count', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'kafka-connect')).sum().publish(label='destroyed')
